page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.n1.small is an entry-level virtual server instance within the shared family, hosted on the KVM hypervisor. It is configured with an x86_64 Intel Xeon 8269CY processor clocked at 2.5 GHz, providing 1 vCPU across 1 physical core with 1 thread. The CPU features 32 KB of L1 data cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and a 35 MB L3 cache, alongside instruction set support for AVX, AVX-512 (including AVX512F and AVX512_VNNI), and hardware-accelerated AES encryption. The instance includes 2.0 GB of system memory, matching a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, and does not include local disk storage or attached GPU accelerators.

Benchmark measurements position the ecs.n1.small in the lowest tier across general computing metrics. The instance achieved single-core and multi-core stress-ng scores of 1026.39, while PassMark recorded an overall CPU score of 1291.58, an encryption score of 401.31, and a database operations score of 532.63. Memory bandwidth reaches 76.38 GB/sec for small cached 16 KB blocks, dropping to 8.4 GB/sec read and 6.9 GB/sec write throughput for larger 256 MB blocks. Web throughput was measured at 0.91 GB/sec, while in-memory Redis SET operations completed at 1.35 million operations per second, with all standard benchmark categories placing in the bottom 10 percent of recorded instances.

Given its minimal compute footprint and lack of bundled local storage, this instance provides a cost-efficient resource tier primarily suitable for non-critical, lightweight environments. Operating with a single thread and 2.0 GB of memory limits performance density under concurrent operations. It is best suited for entry-level tasks such as basic microservices, low-traffic web serving, development environments, and lightweight background automation.
